reason: I already pay an admin to put receipts into Excel. She's behind, sure, but she gets there, and half of what I spend on the scooters is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a bot reading the chat would only see part of it. I might throw the free 30 at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't start paying $19 a month for a job someone on my payroll already does.
objection: $19 a month for something my admin already does. And the bot can't see the cash I hand the mechanics, so the report would make it look like I know where the money went when I don't.
would_change_my_mind: If the free run on my own chat turned up real money I was losing, like a part paid for twice or a fuel receipt with the wrong amount, and it covered more than the $19 a month.
